spec.description: Creates a shallow copy of the raw keys object by iterating over its own enumerable properties. Extracts mouseX and mouseY from the input, substituting 0 when they are falsy or absent. Coerces mouseLeft and mouseRight to booleans, and defaults mouseWheel to 0 if not truthy. Computes mouseTileX and mouseTileY by adding the provided camera offsets (cameraX, cameraY) to the respective mouse coordinates, dividing by the tile size parameter (or a default tile size when omitted), and taking the floor of the result. Accepts any superset of these input fields and silently ignores extras. Returns a new snapshot object with the copied keys, the sanitised mouse position, the booleanised button states, the wheels value, and the derived tile indices. No side effects or state mutation occur.
